# Every theme key in asciidoctor-pdf 2.3's Theme Keys Reference, flattened as the theme loader
# flattens them (`heading: h2: font-size` is `heading_h2_font_size`). `<n>`, `<name>`, `<type>`,
# `<side>` and `<position>` stand for a heading level, a name, a list marker type, `recto` or
# `verso`, and `left`, `center` or `right`.
#
# Taken from docs/modules/theme/pages/*.adoc at asciidoctor-pdf v2.3.15: the category of each
# page's section and the key in the first column of each table row. Where an example in the
# reference disagrees with its own table (`page: columns-gap`, `abstract: text-transform` in the
# first-line table), the table's name is kept. `title_page` is the flag that turns the title page
# on or off; `abstract_title_align` and `sidebar_title_align` are the older names the base theme
# still uses. `$variables` the bundled themes define only for reuse (`base_font_size_large`,
# `vertical_rhythm`) are not keys and are not listed.
